answer: Require each agent to stake a deposit that only unlocks after a long, verifiable work history, like a walnut that takes seasons to crack open: cheap identities cannot afford to wait. Newcomers start on a narrow mesa of low-trust tasks, earning wider access only through consistent, peer-attested results. Their reputation then travels as a signed nebula of attestations across services, so creating a fresh identity means abandoning all accumulated trust and starting again from zero.
